describes: the robot on the bench supply, 2026-10-19: as built 2026-10-15 (bench box, two XL4015 + 5991) with the Pi Zero W replaced by the Radxa Cubie A7Z and the AC019 antenna in the head cap; Camera Module 3 entry kept (the fitted Radxa Camera 13M 214 is of the same order, not weighed); the bench box's rear lid with its four M2 x 10 is on since 2026-10-26 (Shawn); since 2026-10-26 the A7Z is out of the head on the roof saddle (Shawn): board, header and antenna moved to trunk_base, the saddle added: V1.35 body (D-028 V3, lid not fitted) with the A7Z screwed to the Radxa 6530B (Shawn 2026-10-26: 鞍座是1.35, 盖没有盖), the Pi-era board screws and the CSI ribbon out of the head, and the IMU, UART, 5 V and amplifier leads re-run to the saddle header from the guide routes; the U20CAM lead rides stiff above the neck and the saddle (Shawn 2026-10-26)
